annotation.title_clean: Ethically Aligned Design: A Vision for Prioritizing Human Well-being with Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Version 2 - For Public Discussion
annotation.title_en: Ethically Aligned Design: A Vision for Prioritizing Human Well-being with Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Version 2 - For Public Discussion
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems (IEEE-SA)
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: IEEE Global Initiative's Version 2 public-consultation draft of Ethically Aligned Design, setting out general principles (human rights, well-being, accountability, transparency, misuse awareness) and committee-by-committee candidate recommendations for autonomous and intelligent systems, including robots, autonomous weapons, law, and personal data, to inspire IEEE P7000 standards and policy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five General Principles: human rights, well-being, accountability, transparency, and awareness of misuse.
A/IS should not be granted rights equal to humans and must remain subordinate to human judgment and control.
Registration and record-keeping so the legally responsible party for each A/IS can always be identified.
Develop measurable, testable transparency standards (IEEE P7001), e.g. ethical black box for accident investigation.
Meaningful human control and audit trails for autonomous weapons; inspires IEEE P7000 series standards.
